trigger.rule: H9 terminal INCONCLUSIVE and its immutable preregistration requires route review after FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE

questions: Did H9 produce any valid control-versus-treatment method evidence?
Was H9 terminal because of the registered method or because of an external protocol violation?
Does Route Review005's prospective SmoothL1 hypothesis remain untested and causally supported?
Is a separately registered clean H10 rerun the smallest non-post-hoc successor?
Would changing method, source, gates, sample size or official-eval policy now confound the unresolved H9 question?
Is the HYBRID route family exhausted?
candidate_actions: H10 clean fresh same-start rerun of the exact H9 MSE-versus-SmoothL1 design
launch H9 treatment from the partial control
change SmoothL1 beta, source, gates or sample size
skip directly to a new critic or opponent-pool method
launch unregistered Slumbot calibration from the partial H9 checkpoint
decision_rule: Select a clean H10 rerun only if H9 has zero valid method evidence, the terminal cause is external protocol contamination, Route Review005's hypothesis remains prospective, the exact H8 source is still immutable, and H10 can freeze the same single variable, sample, gates and no-official-hands rule while adding only reporting/control-plane isolation hardening. Never resume H9, use its partial checkpoint, relax gates, tune beta, reopen W1 or infer method failure from the incident.
inference_limits: H9 supports only an operational incident conclusion. It supplies no SmoothL1 method effect, no candidate adoption and no external strength evidence.
